answer: Pay is leave-one-out: each grader earns for forecasting the typical score of the other six, and never counts toward anyone sharing its funding grove. About 5% of lines are onyx canaries with known scores; two misses in a row cost the seat. A cheap model passes those, so colluders still upvote farm lines. Cheapest bypass: win 4 of 7 drawn seats with unlinked wallets; at pool share s the odds per panel are about 35s^4(1-s)^3 (s=10%: 1 in 370), cost linear in wallets. Any funding bridge between wallets merges them, voiding cross-pay.
